# Paramveer Singh Bhele

> Software engineer building AI systems, backend infrastructure, and production products.

Paramveer Singh Bhele is a University of South Florida Computer Science graduate and Columbia University M.S. Artificial Intelligence student focused on AI Infrastructure.

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio](https://paramveerbhele.com/portfolio/): Selected work, experience, education, leadership, recognition, skills, and contact information.
- [Resume](https://paramveerbhele.com/portfolio/resume.pdf): Downloadable professional resume.

## Selected work

- [Polaris](https://github.com/Param-10/hackthebay): GitHub App that reviews Infrastructure-as-Code pull requests, maps findings to security controls, and verifies generated fixes. [Live demo](https://polaris-livid-one.vercel.app/) · [Devpost](https://devpost.com/software/polaris-szhivy)
- [PR Nutrition](https://github.com/Param-10/pr-nutrition): Local-first TypeScript CLI and GitHub Action that prioritizes pull-request review risk and points reviewers to the changes that deserve attention first. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pr-nutrition)
- [Adversarial Spam Detection](https://github.com/Param-10/adversarial-spam-detection): BERT and Qwen adversarial training pipeline that improved adversarial detection from 91.7% to 95.7% while maintaining 96.5% accuracy.
- [CarbonCTRL](https://github.com/Param-10/CarbonCTRL): Carbon management platform and winner of the MLH Best Use of Gemini API award at HackaBull 2025. [Devpost](https://devpost.com/software/carbonctrl)
- [Coefficient Software Systems](https://coefficientindia.com/): Production corporate website rebuilt with Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, and Lenis. [Source](https://github.com/Param-10/bluewave-revamp)

## Other work

- [BullRunner](https://param-10.github.io/bullrunner-2/): Map-first USF transit application using live Passio data. [Source](https://github.com/Param-10/bullrunner-2)
- [Fraud Detection Dashboard](https://fraud-detector-dashboard.netlify.app/): Interactive fraud-analysis dashboard for transaction CSV uploads, risk visualizations, and model predictions. [Source](https://github.com/Param-10/Fraud-Detection-Dashboard)
